message.content: The booking policy for the 'Company Pool Car' resource type (Policy ID: 3, "Pool Car Field Sales Policy") has been updated. It now includes a maximum duration of 8 hours (480 minutes) and a cancellation window of 2 hours (120 minutes). Additionally, the 'field_sales' permission (Permission ID: 3) has been attached to this policy to ensure only users with that permission can book the resource.
